name: EEG Foundation Challenge
description: The EEG Foundation Challenge focuses on developing models for zero-shot decoding of cognitive tasks and subjects from EEG data, and predicting latent psychopathology factors from EEG signals.

cr:input.name: HBN-EEG Dataset
cr:input.description: High-density EEG recordings (128 channels) from over 3,000 participants aged 5-21 years, engaged in six cognitive tasks (Resting State, Surround Suppression, Movie Watching, Contrast Change Detection, Sequence Learning, Symbol Search). Includes demographic attributes (age, gender, handedness) and four psychopathology factors (internalization, externalization, attention, p-factor). Data is formatted in the BIDS standard and includes event annotations using HED.
